description: Closed exact-path exemption registry for the typed-ID fixture gates (check_typed_id_fixture_value_closure and the digest-suite wire-code check in the fixture pass). Every concrete typed ID a conformance fixture ships MUST be a registered wire form of registry/id-kind-registry.json. A fixture legitimately carries a few strings that wear a typed-ID prefix and MUST NOT be a registered form: a negative vector whose value only exists to be rejected, and a documented wire-form template. Those cases are declared here by exact JSON pointer, carrier position and pinned value, never inferred from a field name such as negative_cases, reject_* or invalid_*, because an authoring convention is not a contract and a gate that trusted one would let any future value opt out by renaming its key. Editing the value ends its exemption, and an entry that stops matching a failing occurrence is reported as stale.

positions.value: The whole JSON string is the identifier.
positions.object_key: The object member name is the identifier.
positions.embedded_json_string: A JSON string literal embedded in a longer string, such as canonical JSON inside a digest preimage.

categories.deliberate_negative_vector: The fixture publishes this value as an input that MUST be rejected. Its whole purpose is that it is not a registered wire form, so correcting it would delete the vector.
categories.wire_form_template: The string is a readable wire-form shape carrying placeholders, in the same style as a registry wire_form, and denotes no concrete identifier.

entries.reason: The case is named invalid_event_id_suite_rejected and expects unsupported_digest_algorithm; the token decodes to 33 octets whose leading digest-suite wire code is the permanently disabled 0x0, which is exactly the property under test. Repairing the value would delete the vector.
The case is named invalid_base64url and expects reason_code invalid_cursor; the payload is outside the registered ak:cursor: alphabet [A-Za-z0-9_-]+ on purpose, which is the property under test.

The field states the accepted blob-ref shape rather than one blob ref; the alternation and the <64 lowercase hex> placeholder are template syntax, and the registered value space it restates is special_forms[blob].payload_pattern.
Case cell_ref_with_malformed_percent_escape_rejected declares expect_valid false; the truncated percent-escape is exactly what bottom.schema.json must reject.
Case cell_ref_without_complete_ak_component_family_rejected declares expect_valid false; the missing ak.component.<facet-path>.v<n> family is exactly what bottom.schema.json must reject.

Case realm_state_snapshot_chunk_actor_private_family_rejected declares expect_valid false; an actor-private ak.private.* family is exactly what realm-state-snapshot-chunk.schema.json cell_ref must reject (realm-state-snapshot-schema.md section 3: actor-private cells are not Realm consensus state).

The typed_pair negative vector deliberately gives the Board component a non-canonical Space token and requires every producer and receiver parser to reject it rather than accepting a partially typed pair.

The typed_pair negative vector deliberately gives the Strand component a non-canonical Strand token and requires every producer and receiver parser to reject it rather than accepting a partially typed pair.
